question: Rebakanta Mahanta, who was awarded the Padma Shri in January 2025, is renowned for which art form?
solution:
p data-end="57" data-start="0">The correct answer is __**Bamboo mask-making**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Rebakanta Mahanta** is a master craftsman from **Assam** who has dedicated over six decades to the preservation and promotion of **Mukha Shilpa**, the traditional art of **bamboo mask-making**.
 
• In **January 2025**, the Government of India announced the **Padma Shri** award for him in the field of **Art**, recognizing his exceptional contribution to the cultural heritage of **Assam**.
 
• He is based in **Sivasagar** district and is associated with the **Khatpar Satra**, where he has been instrumental in teaching this ancient art form to the younger generation to ensure its survival.
 
• His expertise lies in creating intricate masks used in **Bhaona**, a traditional form of **Satriya** mythological theatre. These masks are traditionally made from **bamboo**, **clay**, and **cloth**.
 
• Through his **Samaguri-style** influences and his own innovations, he has made the masks more flexible and lightweight, allowing performers to use them more effectively during **Satriya** dance and drama performances.
